event.description: Share feed-forward transforms as well as QKV across depth
event.proposal: Family: parameter tying. Current retained frontier is 2,656 parameters at 99.980000%, a +0.980000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There has been 1 prior attempt in this family: attempt-0026 is the accepted shared-QKV result at 2,656 parameters and 99.98%, and there is no failed in-family result. The most recent failures, attempts 0027 and 0028 in feed-forward width, show that direct deletion of even one trained unit per block destroys exact-sequence accuracy. Hypothesis: instead of deleting nonlinear channels, both depth steps can reuse the complete width-16 feed-forward transform while retaining independent pre-attention and pre-FF LayerNorm affine parameters and distinct residual states. Fresh training can co-adapt this recurrent transform, yielding 2,144 unique parameters. This is more informative than the nearest untested partial tie of only one feed-forward matrix because it directly tests whether layer specialization resides in normalization/residual state rather than either half of the nonlinear transform, with a larger measurable compression.
